# Inflow React

> @inriver/inflow-react is Inriver's React/MUI design-system library: a scoped theme, design tokens, and themed components for product UIs.

## Install and setup

Install `@inriver/inflow-react` with React 19, React DOM 19, MUI 9, @emotion/react and @emotion/styled. Wrap your app in `<InflowProvider>` imported from `@inriver/inflow-react`. Set a distinct `cacheKey` for each independently deployed microfrontend. `mode` is `light` by default; the app controls light or dark mode. Bundled fonts and icons are optional: import `@inriver/inflow-react/local-assets.css` once in your global CSS entry.

## CLI

The package includes the `inflow` binary. Use `inflow --help`, `inflow component --list`, `inflow component ThemedChip`, `inflow tokens`, `inflow search chip`, or `inflow docs setup` (also `theming` and `migration`). Add `--json` for a machine-readable envelope. Unknown input exits 1.

## Token overrides

The provider emits 112 `--infl-*` variables on `[data-inflow-root]`, derived from the resolved theme. Override individual variables with the provider `sx` prop or CSS scoped to that root, not `:root`. Portaled content does not inherit these variables by default. See [Theming](https://inriver.github.io/inflow-react/#/theming) and [Design tokens](https://inriver.github.io/inflow-react/#/tokens).
